sm_top.sm: Houthi missile and drone attacks targeting Riyadh airport killed 13 people and injured 17 others.
Israel prepared a large-scale West Bank operation following an attack that killed two Israeli soldiers.
Houthi drone attacks targeted Dammam and the Shaybah oil field, resulting in multiple casualties including deaths and injuries.
Reports indicate the United States is preparing potential military strikes against Iran as President Trump warns of future actions.
Russian missiles and drones targeted Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine, causing casualties.
Ukraine targeted Russia with a large-scale drone attack, successfully striking an oil terminal in St. Petersburg.
A drone strike on an Abyei market highlighted fuel networks connected to the Sudan war.
A vessel caught fire and sank off the European coast in the Black Sea following a drone attack.
Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip resulted in multiple Palestinian deaths and injuries.
A Houthi siege and shelling in Taiz caused severe shortages and casualties, pushing hospitals toward collapse.
The death toll from a church attack in Karak, Jordan, rose to eight.
Two men were re-arrested in the UK for assisting Iranian intelligence in a suspected arson plot targeting RAF Fairford.
Iran reported that oil tankers were damaged in the Strait of Hormuz.
US President Trump stated that the US may conduct another military operation against Iran.
The United States withdrew diplomats from Saudi Arabia amid worsening tensions with the Houthis and Iran.
Escalating fighting in Yemen has displaced over 233,000 people and caused a severe humanitarian and hunger crisis.
Reports indicated that Iran plans to strike undersea communications cables in the Persian Gulf if attacked again.
The Yemeni army stated that 620 Houthi fighters were neutralized over a 24-hour period.
Poland scrambled fighter jets in response to Russian strikes in western Ukraine.
Ukrainian forces conducted drone strikes against Moscow and a weapons facility in Serpukhov.
Russian airstrikes hit apartment blocks in Sloviansk, killing six people and leaving others trapped under rubble.
The IRGC reported that two oil supertankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian drone attacks disrupted operations at Moscow airports, leading to flight suspensions and air defense interceptions.
An oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported that defense forces shot down or neutralized 140 of 176 enemy drones, with hits recorded at 19 locations.
Russia launched 126 drones at Ukraine, with Ukrainian air defenses neutralizing 101 of them.
An investigation revealed that the RSF systematically targeted the healthcare system in El Fasher.
A Russian strike on a market in Lozova killed two people and caused a DTEK power plant to stop generating electricity.
Ukrainian drones launched an attack on a chemical plant in Tolyatti, triggering a massive fire.
A Houthi attack on a Saudi airport resulted in two deaths and several injuries.
A Russian daytime attack on civilian businesses in Chernihiv killed 1 person and injured at least 25 others.
A drone strike hit a market town in Sudan as the UN reported hundreds of deaths from drone attacks in October.
Sudan denied responsibility for a drone strike on Amiet Market in Abyei that reportedly killed 220 people.
Israel conducted strikes in southern Lebanon, killing 4,386 people, while a drone was observed flying over Beirut.
Ukraine confirms strikes on the Proton plant, Tolyatti, and Yeysk airfield in Russia.
Russian Ministry of Defence claims strikes on Ukrainian energy and transport infrastructure, drone storage and launch sites, and temporary deployment areas across 147 districts.
Russian MoD claimed air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 616 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least 8 people and injured 67 over the past day.
Red Cross reports drone attacks in Sudan are killing hundreds, targeting homes, markets, and displacement camps.
Russian MoD claims drone strikes hit the Novokyivska substation in Hotiv, the Zhytomyrska substation in Zhytomyr, and two dry cargo ships.
